messages:
maya: quick copy pass request — API key rotation revoke flow. current modal reads:

`Revoke API Key? This will immediately invalidate the key and any services using it will stop working.`

Can we make this clearer and gentler for users who might be unaware of dependent services? also accessibility / screen-reader concerns for the toast that appears after revoke.

ian: i like keeping it direct but less abrupt. proposal:

`Revoke API key? The key will stop working immediately. Any apps or services using this key will lose access until you update them.`

kevin: tiny nit: "stop working" is slightly informal. maybe `be invalidated` is better for copy consistency across console. also add a short line about recovery: how to create a new key. how about:

`Revoke API key? This key will be invalidated immediately. Any apps or services using it will lose access until you create and update a replacement key.`

samira: accessibility: ensure the modal has role="alertdialog" and the revoke action is announced. For the toast after revoke, avoid vague copy. current toast: `Key revoked` — not helpful. suggested toast: `API key revoked — create a new key to restore access.` add aria-live="polite" for the toast so screen readers read it but not interruptively.

maya: love those tweaks. two more microcopy alternatives for the modal CTA buttons:
- Primary button: `Revoke key` (concise)
- Secondary: `Cancel`

or, to reduce accidental clicks, we could make primary more explicit: `Revoke key now` and change secondary to `Keep key` — thoughts?

ian: prefer the concise `Revoke key`. adding "now" can feel alarmist. but maybe we should add a confirmation checkbox for high-impact org-level keys: `I understand this will disrupt services` to force a deliberate action. the checkbox label should be short. suggestions: `I understand this will stop services using this key.`

kevin: checkbox is good for org keys. for personal keys, not necessary. also consider adding a small helper tooltip to the info icon next to the modal header: `Why revoke? Use this to rotate keys or disable compromised credentials.` Keep tooltip copy short (1 sentence).

samira: tooltip accessibility: ensure tooltip content is reachable by keyboard and has aria-describedby linking to the info icon. suggested tooltip copy: `Rotate keys regularly or revoke if a key may be compromised.`

designbot: accessibility checklist reminder: modal has accessible title, focus trap enabled, primary button is `aria-describedby` with consequence summary, and post-action toast uses `aria-live="polite"`. Also recommend link to docs in modal footer: `Learn how to rotate keys` (opens in new tab).

maya: final suggested modal body (single pass):

`Revoke API key?
This key will be invalidated immediately. Any apps or services using it will lose access until you create and update a replacement key.`

Checkbox (only for org-level keys): `I understand this will stop services using this key.`

Buttons: [Revoke key] [Cancel]

Post-action toast (aria-live=polite): `API key revoked — create a replacement key to restore access. Learn how to rotate keys →`

kevin: LGTM. can we shorten the toast for mobile screens to `Key revoked — create a replacement.` and keep the longer version on desktop? maybe automatic truncation.

maya: noted. i'll update the mock and push to figma. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

ian: tiny follow-up: add an analytics event name `api_key.revoked.confirm` and record whether checkbox was checked. we can review later.

samira: will verify aria-live behavior in the QA pass.

maya: closing thread — will post updated screenshot once in figma.
